description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_mailto' that extends the base URI scheme class to handle and validate 'mailto' URIs according to RFC 2368. It includes a method to validate the URI, stripping user info, host, and port components.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_mailto
classes.description: A class to handle 'mailto' URI scheme validation compliant with RFC 2368, overriding validation behavior and making the URI not browsable.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Overrides parent validate method to reset user info, host, and port parts of the URI and perform validation according to RFC 2368.
